title: [Global Home - Hero Travelers Popover] Travelers Dialog Hardcodes left: 16px Detached From Trigger (311px Offset on 1920px) & Clamps Height Hiding Cancel/OK Behind Inner Scrollbar
environment: Staging (STAG) · Desktop 1920×1080 & 1440×900, Laptop 1280×800, Tablet 768×1024, Mobile 375×667 · Chrome 145 · en-US (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/home)
steps_to_reproduce: Open https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/home at Desktop 1920×1080 (and 1440×900) with scrollY = 0.
Click the 'Travelers · 2 guests' field (.gns-home-hero-field-travelers) inside the Hero Request Form.
Measure getBoundingClientRect() of the Travelers trigger vs the opened div[role='dialog'] popover.

Resize to 1440×900, 1280×800, 768×1024 (iPad), and 375×667, re-open 'Travelers · 2 guests', and inspect dialog height vs scrollHeight and visibility of the 'Pets' row and 'Cancel / OK' action buttons.
actual_result:
- Across all viewports, clicking 'Travelers' opens div[role='dialog'].fixed.z-50.overflow-y-auto hardcoded to left: 16px instead of anchoring to the Travelers field:
  • On 1920×1080 Desktop, the Hero Form starts at left: 312px and the Travelers trigger sits at left: 327px, yet the dialog renders 311px to the left at left: 16px (width: 425px), floating over the empty hero background image.
  • On 1440×900 Desktop, the form starts at left: 72px (trigger at left: 87px), while the dialog juts 56px outside the form's left edge at left: 16px.
- Vertically, the dialog clamps its height below its natural content height (scrollHeight: 418px on desktop/tablet, 475px on 375px mobile) even when ample viewport height exists:
  • 1440×900: height 365px vs scrollHeight 418px; 1280×800: height 342px vs 418px; 768×1024: height 258px vs 418px; 375×667: height 273px vs 475px — cutting off 'Pets' and the 'Cancel / OK' confirmation buttons behind an inner scrollbar while obscuring Destination and Check-in fields.
- Stacking context uses z-index: 50 (identical to .gns-home-nav-stage-overlay), inconsistent with Check-in Calendar (.ota-stay-cal-v2, z-index: 100000).
expected_result:
- On Desktop/Tablet, the Travelers popover must anchor horizontally to its trigger field (.gns-home-hero-field-travelers) and flip/position vertically so all 4 guest rows ('Adults', 'Children', 'Infants', 'Pets') and 'Cancel / OK' buttons render at full height (~418px) without unnecessary internal scrolling.
- On Mobile, it should render as a clean bottom sheet or centered modal with consistent portal z-index parity matching .ota-stay-cal-v2 and .gns-home-prop-portal.

evidence.console: 0 uncaught JS errors; div[role='dialog'] computed left: '16px', position: 'fixed', zIndex: '50', overflowY: 'auto'.
evidence.notes: Same-page component parity comparison: Check-in Calendar (.ota-stay-cal-v2) centers cleanly at x=627px on 1920×1080 (z-index: 100000) and switches to .is-sheet bottom sheet on mobile; Property Type (.gns-home-prop-portal) anchors directly beneath its trigger (x=540px on 1920×1080) and uses .is-sheet on mobile. Only Travelers popover hardcodes left: 16px and clamps height.

classification: Confirmed Bug — UI/UX & Responsive Popover Positioning Defect
